main_text.p: GHeta, Vota: alibi gheta, vide betting Hoc Sax. ȝeħaȼ, & beħaȼ, unde bebigbt in Psalterio nostro metri-co (ut vocant) sæpius obvium, eo sensu. Sax. beħeħȼ.
Glawou, Prudentem Prudens Sax. ȝleap. Legum etiam periti eis Æȝleā-pan dicti, ab eorum Æ, Lex, & eodem ȝleap, peritus.
Gitowe, Disciplina: supra getu-wing Mos, Ritus, Sax. ȝeȏȳpe, aliās ȝeȏeap?
Gitwepene, Arma: quasi getwae-pene Sax. arma, pæpn, unde nostrum eodem sensu, weapon. Hoc Belg. wa-pen: Germ. waffen.
Getwittenon, Afflictus Pœna, tor-tura, mulĉta, Saxon. pıȝe; Tortores, pıȝenepeȝ; punire, pıȝnian?
Glidie, Lubricum: & glidert, lapsu Lubricum Sax. ȝlio, unde nostratium to glide & glidung, eo sensu. Hinc forte Milvus, Sax. ȝlioa dictus.
Gothebten, Cogitationibus: nos ge-dachten Cogitatio, Saxon. ȝeȏohȝ, unde nostratium thought, illo sensu.
Gzuoba, Lacus: quasi groeve, nobis fossa Ejusdem (forte) originis ac nostrūm
